Name: Drawberry's Seasonal Cute Characters for Rodney O'Brien
Author: drawberry138
Description:
[b]I do NOT consent to my work being used to train AI or used in AI generation.[/b]

Oh hi!

If you’re a Seasonal Cute Characters fan like me - I’ve made a cute sprite and portrait mod for Rodney O'Brien!

This mod REQUIRES Rodney O'Brien and its requirements, Content Patcher, and SMAPI. 

I RECOMMEND you download Poltergeister's[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450] Vanilla [/url]and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16045]ES[/url] seasonal cute character mods, as well as my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43012]East Scarp Remastered [/url]mod for a unified look!

For other East Scarp residents, I've also made mods for the base cast's festival outfits, and sprite/portrait mods for East Scarp Remastered, Nora the Herpetologist, the Bear Fam, Eli and Dylan, and Metalcore goes Cottagecore!

Installation:

﻿
[list]
[*]download the mod[/*]
[*]drag it into your mods folder and unzip![/*]
[/list]
Features:
[list]
[*]configurable noses[/*]
[*]cute sprites and portraits for Rodney![/*]
[/list]
If you like playing with this mod please consider endorsing it - I’m disabled and bedridden, so any support that can get my work out there helps!

I really hope you enjoy my work! Much love and take care, Drawberry xo

I repeat, DO NOT use my work in AI generation in any shape or form. 

Special thanks to: 
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/TheFrenchDodo]Dodo[/url] for kindly giving me permission to create and publish this mod,
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Fellowclown]FellowClown[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/AirynS]Airyn[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/TheFrenchDodo]Dodo[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/6480]6480[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/maddogofblank]Mads[/url] for their work on Rodney’s original portrait design and/or outfits,
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Abagaianye]Abagaianye[/url] for being so generous with their time and patience, 
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Poltergeister]Poltergeister[/url] for giving permission to create cute sprites and for her work as a jumping point for my own
and my brother for uploading this mod for me. you're the goat of all time
